name: unchained_berserker_attacking_toughness_stays_1
notes: G3 (amount+1 at 1/0/effect/args/toughness/magnitude). Printed: 'This creature gets +2/+0 as long as it's attacking.' The bonus is to power only: the 1/1 Berserker attacks as a 3/1. P1's green 1/1 Elf blocks it; each deals combat damage to the other and both die (the Berserker's toughness is still 1). No damage reaches P1.
